contributions.statement: When an agent writes both code and its tests, accept a candidate only through a harness-owned hidden audit that compares it with the incumbent, returns only accept/reject, and rolls back on regression.
contributions.evidence: Finding 1 Table 4: all valid cells end with self-score >= 0.70 while 15/35 score below random; Tables 5/7: SEAL beats unprotected loops for 6/6 Breakout models and 11/12 cross-game cells, with wide half-ranges. Atari policies, not code services.

reason: A tested, multi-model gate design that matches the 'LLM proposes, qr verifies' rule; the evidence is Atari policies and few seeds, so it transfers as a design principle.
